where: world-eaters army rule · Blessings of Khorne

judgement.sumSt: If Unbridled Bloodlust is active: +1 to Charge rolls

source.text:
If your Army Faction is **WORLD EATERS**, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne (see below). Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires (where a number is specified, a double or triple of that value or higher is required). You can only activate each Blessing of Khorne once per battle round. Any unused dice from the Blessings of Khorne roll are then discarded. Once activated, each Blessing of Khorne applies to all units from your army with this ability until the end of the battle round.
*Example: Ash makes a Blessings of Khorne roll, getting the following: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 6.*
*First they use the two 6s to activate Warp Blades (which requires a double 5+), leaving the following dice: 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4.*
*They then use the two 2s to activate Unbridled Bloodlust.*
*Now that two Blessings of Khorne have been activated, no more can be activated and the remaining dice are discarded.*
Unbridled Bloodlust · double 1+: This unit has +1 to **charge rolls**.
Rage-fuelled Invigoration · double 2+: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or **Consolidation move**, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
Total Carnage · double 3+: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Martial Excellence · double 4+ or triple 1+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.
Warp Blades · double 5+ or triple 2+: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.
Decapitating Strikes · double 6 or triple 3+: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an **INFANTRY** unit, that attack has the **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** ability.

where: verify/waha-loadout.js (every datasheet of the four catalogues, from-waha without --write)

rules: "For each X this model is equipped with, it can be equipped with Y": an addition per X, per:X, taken once for each X the model has after its swaps (Helbrute)
an alternative of "one of the following:" may be a name alone ("- Castellan Axe"), one of it
a swap of "X and Y" takes each where each is a weapon or wargear of the swap’s model ("Pyrithite Spear and Praesidium Shield"); builder.js does not look for wargear among the weapons it matches
"Every X added to this unit using the <ability> ability is equipped with: …": later, models gained in the battle, none an export has (Split)
a swap or addition whose alternatives were not read is unread, never an empty choice
unreadBefore: world-eaters/helbrute  ::  For each Helbrute fist this model is equipped with, it can be equipped with one of the following: 1 combi-bolter; 1 heavy flamer
chaos-daemons/blue-horrors  ::  Every Brimstone Horror added to this unit using the Split ability is equipped with: Coruscating Yellow Flames; yellow claws.
chaos-daemons/pink-horrors  ::  Every Blue Horror added to this unit using the Split ability is equipped with: Coruscating Blue Flames; blue claws.
chaos-daemons/pink-horrors  ::  Every Brimstone Horror added to this unit using the Split ability is equipped with: Coruscating Yellow Flames; yellow claws.

judgement.rule: a value of the export other than GW’s that no rule reaching the unit could change (no box of it as reader 1 read it, counted or not, no BUILD_INDEX.marks entry, no words of it naming that characteristic, "… Ballistic Skill … characteristic" or "+1 BS", or that weapon) is the export’s own data: GW’s value is built and said in the list’s note ("Values: GW’s are used where the export’s differ"), as BUILD_INDEX.gw does for the owner’s lists; a rule that could change it and does not give that value: refused, as before; a weapon keyword the export adds: refused, as before
judgement.why: New Recruit’s data can lag GW (the World Eaters Faction Pack 1.3 changed the Bolt pistol to S5 AP-1 for Khorne Berzerkers, Lord Invocatus and Master of Executions, the Combi-bolter of the vehicles, Terminators and Helbrute, Chainblades, T6 Chaos Terminators, T5 Khârn, Berzerkers and Master of Executions, the Heldrake M12 OC0 and no AIRCRAFT): each of those, printed as before the pack, now builds with GW’s and the note (checked: Invocatus’s Bolt pistol S4 AP0, Chaos Terminators T5); no export of the friend’s is here, so the BS 2+ is their report, made up as such

where: effects.js ST advanceAdd and chargeAdd; verify/effects-extract.js statOf, statNc; verify/lines.js LS

judgement.home: a unit’s Advance and Charge rolls are lines under its profile, as a characteristic’s (no other column or line kind for them existed): an army or detachment rule’s words "add N to (Advance and) Charge rolls made for that/this unit", "this unit has +N to charge rolls", "Friendly X units have +N to charge rolls" are stat boxes (BOXES st, its conditions and the units it names); any other source’s words that change them are its snc ("Charge", "Advance"), as a characteristic’s are. reader2 does not read them: the stat boxes fall back (AGREE), each drawn from its words with its summary
